success_patterns: Refinement turns on a cached domain are three straight lines (load the most refined key, filter with ONLY the last turn's new constraint, save under a new key). This covered restaurant neighborhood 'Downtown Raleigh', restaurant budget 125 with gluten-free already in the summary, and hotel budget 1075 plus pool_present with pet-friendly and kids club already in the summary. The earlier-turn constraints were not re-passed.

Turns with an empty CACHE and no check-in/check-out dates ('hotel in St. Louis for a weekend getaway', 'last-minute trip, 75 per night', 'flight Portland to Raleigh and hotel in Raleigh') produced a single seek_information naming only the missing mandatory items. There was no search, no guessed dates and no filter on a budget or amenity reply.

A specific attraction name given when the CACHE has hotels but no attractions key ('Tony Knowles Coastal Trail', city known from the hotel search) produced only `search_attractions(city=..., attraction_name=[...])` saved as 'attractions'. The hotel keys were left untouched and no type was invented.

'Not really, I'm flexible' with an attractions entry already cached is a no-new-constraint reply (the correct output is a plain cache retrieval). The agent re-searched instead, and that run scored only on cache_em, so it is not a pattern to encode.
